newsitem.title: GERMANY: Weaker data trigger German debt market rally.
newsitem.headline: Weaker data trigger German debt market rally.

text.p: German debt, surprising even bullish traders, cleared several key resistance levels in Wednesday trading, as soft German economic data and the U.S. Treasury market' early gains paved the way for hefty profits.

"Frankly I did not think we could reach these levels, but after vaulting past one or two resistance levels, we saw technical buy signals and the entire market just seems to be moving ever higher," said one dealer.
Though poised to hold convincingly above the old contract high of 101.92 this morning, the day's unexpected rally was triggered by much weaker than expected German economic data.
